summary: Verified all 4 bug fixes for ClauseGuard app. All fixes are working correctly: 1) AI Search triggers search when clicked and shows AI analysis, 2) PDF export includes full clause text (fetches from acquisition.gov if needed), 3) Upload missing clauses fetches from acquisition.gov, 4) Dashboard buttons have type='button' attribute.

bugs_verified_this_iteration.bug: AI Search not working when clicked
bugs_verified_this_iteration.verification: AI Search button triggers search when clicked (if query exists). When authenticated, returns AI analysis and AI explanations for each clause. When not authenticated, shows 'Please sign in to use AI search' toast (expected behavior).

bugs_verified_this_iteration.bug: PDF export shows description instead of full clause text
bugs_verified_this_iteration.verification: PDF export endpoint fetches full text from acquisition.gov if not in local DB. Verified PDF contains 'Full Text:' section with actual clause content.

bugs_verified_this_iteration.bug: Upload missing clauses error 'No clause found to upload'
bugs_verified_this_iteration.verification: Upload endpoint now ALWAYS tries to fetch from acquisition.gov if clause not in local DB or missing text. Verified clause 52.212-5 was fetched and stored with 50,000 chars of text.

bugs_verified_this_iteration.bug: Dashboard button causes save password popup on some pages
bugs_verified_this_iteration.verification: Dashboard buttons on SearchResults, ClauseDetail, and AgiloftIntegration pages all have type='button' attribute, preventing form submission behavior.
bugs_verified_this_iteration.test_method: Browser automation - verified button type attribute
